+def load_image(image_path: str) -> bytes | None:
+    """Load only inline images or objects from the configured storage bucket."""
+    if not image_path:
+        return None
+    try:
+        if image_path.startswith("data:image"):
+            header, encoded = image_path.split(",", 1)
+            if not header.lower().endswith(";base64"):
+                return None
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
+
+        parsed = urlsplit(image_path)
+        if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc:
+            host = urlsplit(settings.STORAGE_HOST)
+            if (parsed.scheme.lower(), parsed.netloc.lower()) != (host.scheme.lower(), host.netloc.lower()):
+                return None
+            if parsed.username or parsed.password or parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
+                return None
+            prefix = host.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+            if not parsed.path.startswith(prefix):
+                return None
+            key = unquote(parsed.path[len(prefix):])
+        else:
+            if parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
+                return None
+            key = unquote(parsed.path)
+        if not key or key.startswith("/") or "\\" in key or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/")):
+            return None
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception:
+        return None

+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+
+def test_export_reports_missing_cuts(client, monkeypatch):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project = client.post('/api/v1/projects', headers=headers, json={'title': 'Test', 'genres': []}).json()
+    episode = client.post('/api/v1/episodes', headers=headers, json={'title': 'Episode', 'project_id': project['id'], 'episode_order': 1}).json()
+    data = 'data:image/png;base64,' + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()
+    paths = [data, None, 'http://127.0.0.1/secret', 'images/missing.png', 'images/invalid.png']
+    monkeypatch.setattr(storage, 'download_image', lambda key: b'not an image' if key == 'images/invalid.png' else None)
+    cuts = []
+    for number, path in enumerate(paths, 1):
+        response = client.post('/api/v1/cuts', headers=headers, json={'episode_id': episode['id'], 'cut_order': number, 'image_path': path})
+        assert response.status_code == 200
+        cuts.append(response.json())
+
+    url = '/api/v1/episodes/' + episode['id'] + '/export'
+    for fmt in ('zip', 'webtoon'):
+        response = client.post(url, headers=headers, params={'format': fmt})
+        assert response.status_code == 200
+        assert response.headers['X-Missing-Cuts'] == '2,3,4,5'
+        if fmt == 'zip':
+            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.content)) as archive:
+                assert archive.read('missing.txt') == b'2\n3\n4\n5\n'
+                assert archive.read('Episode_01.png') == PNG
+                assert len(archive.namelist()) == 2
+
+    for cut in cuts[1:]:
+        assert client.put('/api/v1/cuts/' + cut['id'], headers=headers, json={'image_path': data}).status_code == 200
+    for fmt in ('zip', 'webtoon'):
+        response = client.post(url, headers=headers, params={'format': fmt})
+        assert response.status_code == 200
+        assert 'X-Missing-Cuts' not in response.headers
+        if fmt == 'zip':
+            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.content)) as archive:
+                assert 'missing.txt' not in archive.namelist()
+
+    for cut in cuts:
+        assert client.put('/api/v1/cuts/' + cut['id'], headers=headers, json={'image_path': None}).status_code == 200
+    response = client.post(url, headers=headers, params={'format': 'zip'})
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.headers['X-Missing-Cuts'] == '1,2,3,4,5'
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.content)) as archive:
+        assert archive.read('missing.txt') == b'1\n2\n3\n4\n5\n'
+    response = client.post(url, headers=headers, params={'format': 'webtoon'})
+    assert response.status_code == 400
+    assert response.headers['X-Missing-Cuts'] == '1,2,3,4,5'

+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+import requests
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+from app.services.reference_board import download_image
+from app.services.storage import load_image, storage
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def no_http(monkeypatch):
+    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise AssertionError("user image URL was requested")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests, "get", forbidden)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.sessions.Session, "request", forbidden)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", [
+    "http://127.0.0.1/secret", "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
+    "//127.0.0.1/secret", "https://example.com/redirect",
+    settings.STORAGE_HOST + "@evil.example/secret",
+    settings.STORAGE_HOST + "/../secret",
+    settings.STORAGE_HOST + "/%2e%2e/secret",
+])
+def test_image_loaders_reject_untrusted_urls(url, monkeypatch):
+    calls = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(storage, "download_image", lambda key: calls.append(key))
+    assert load_image(url) is None
+    assert BaseAIService.__new__(BaseAIService)._download_image(url) is None
+    assert download_image(url) is None
+    assert calls == []
+
+
+def test_image_loaders_support_storage_and_data(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(storage, "download_image", lambda key: PNG if key == "images/test.png" else None)
+    data = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()
+    for path in ("images/test.png", settings.STORAGE_HOST + "/images/test.png", data):
+        assert load_image(path) == PNG
+        assert BaseAIService.__new__(BaseAIService)._download_image(path) == PNG
+        assert download_image(path) is not None
+
+
+def test_export_skips_user_url_and_keeps_storage_and_data(client, monkeypatch):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project = client.post('/api/v1/projects', headers=headers, json={'title': 'Test', 'genres': []}).json()
+    episode = client.post('/api/v1/episodes', headers=headers, json={'title': 'Episode', 'project_id': project['id'], 'episode_order': 1}).json()
+    cut = client.post('/api/v1/cuts', headers=headers, json={'episode_id': episode['id'], 'cut_order': 1}).json()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(storage, 'download_image', lambda key: PNG if key == 'images/test.png' else None)
+    for path, expected in [('http://127.0.0.1/secret', False), ('images/test.png', True), (settings.STORAGE_HOST + '/images/test.png', True), ('data:image/png;base64,' + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode(), True)]:
+        assert client.put('/api/v1/cuts/' + cut['id'], headers=headers, json={'image_path': path}).status_code == 200
+        for fmt in ('zip', 'webtoon'):
+            response = client.post('/api/v1/episodes/' + episode['id'] + '/export', params={'format': fmt}, headers=headers)
+            assert response.status_code == (200 if expected or fmt == 'zip' else 400), response.text if not expected else response.status_code
+            if expected and fmt == 'zip':
+                with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.content)) as archive:
+                    assert archive.read(archive.namelist()[0]) == PNG
